title: Exploitation rights
text:
This measure helps UK double taxation agreements to work in a clear, consistent and internationally aligned way.

 Making sure that profits from rights connected to the extraction of UK natural resources, held by businesses and individuals, can be taxed in the UK.
changeNote: The effective date of this measure in respect of profits arising on or after 1 April 2027 for Corporation Tax purposes has changed. This measure will now have effect for accounting periods beginning on or after 13 July 2026 for Corporation Tax and for profits arising from 6 April 2027 for Income Tax.
